BiblicalUsage: Sâgâh carries the sense of to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively). It stands in Job 8:7, "…small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase", and in Psalms 73:12, "…ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put sâgâh here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
